$comment: ask-from-reply settings. Copy this file to <agent dir>/ask-from-reply.config.json (~/.pi/agent/, next to pi's settings.json), or point ASK_FROM_REPLY_CONFIG at it.
"submit": "send" hands the answers straight to the conversation; "editor" only fills the input box so you can edit them first (TUI only — other modes send instead).
"extractionModel": "provider/modelId" of the model that extracts the questions (for example "openai/gpt-4o-mini"); empty uses the session model.
"extractionTimeoutMs": how long the extraction request may take before it is aborted and reported (1000..600000).
"maxQuestions"/"maxOptions": caps for the questionnaire, also stated in the extraction prompt (1..9 / 2..9).
"replyTailChars": only the last N characters of the reply are shown to the extractor (50..100000).
Read on every run, so no restart is needed; delete a key to get its default back.
